decision_conditions:
Reason : 1 - The proposed development, in the absence of a legal agreement for securing town centre management contributions, would be likely to contribute to pressure and demand on the borough's existing management scheme, contrary to policy RE6 (Planning Obligations) of the London Borough of Camden UDP 2000 and Section 3.2 of the London Borough of Camden SPG 2002.
Reason : 2 - The proposed development, in the absence of a legal agreement for securing transport improvement contributions would be likely to contribute unacceptably to congestion in the surrounding area, contrary to policies TR1 (Public transport accessible development), TR4 (Cumulative impact of proposals), TR5 (Public Transport), TR19 (Road safety), TR21 (Pedestrians) and RE6 (Planning Obligations) of the London Borough of Camden UDP 2000.
Reason : 3 - The proposed development, in the absence of a legal agreement for securing that the development operates in accordance with the existing travel, would be likely to contribute unacceptably to congestion in the surrounding area, contrary to policies TR4 (Cumulative impact of proposals), TR5 (Public Transport), TR19 (Road safety), TR20 (Traffic management), TR21 (Pedestrians) and RE6 (Planning Obligations) of the London Borough of Camden UDP 2000.
Reason : 4 - The proposed development, in the absence of a legal agreement for securing that the site will operate in accordance with the site servicing plan would be likely to contribute unacceptably to congestion in the surrounding area, contrary to policies TR4 (Cumulative impact of proposals), TR19 (Road safety), TR20 (Traffic management), TR23 (Movement of goods) and RE6 (Planning Obligations) of the London Borough of Camden UDP 2000.
Reason : 5 - The proposed development, in the absence of a legal agreement to secure housing would not adequately contribute to the viability and diversity of the town centre and would be contrary to policies RE5 (Mixed use), RE6 (Planning Obligations) of the London Borough of Camden UDP 2000.
ward: Camden Town with Primrose Hill (Pre May 2022)
description: Creation of two new levels of retail below ground, plus creation of a lower basement level for plant equipment and erection of pods for exits in Morrisons car park at upper ground floor level.
